# telnyx_charges_summary (Data Source)

A summary of the account's charges for a period of up to 31 days, by product.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Charges of October 2026. The period can be at most 31 days.
data "telnyx_charges_summary" "october" {
  start_date = "2026-10-01"
  end_date   = "2026-10-31"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end_date` (String) End date of the summary period
- `start_date` (String) Start date of the summary period

### Read-Only

- `currency` (String) Currency code
- `summary` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--summary))
- `total` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--total))
- `user_email` (String) User email address
- `user_id` (String) User identifier
